import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Identify potential drivers using t-statistics
    t_stats = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] == 'clinical':
            continue  # Skip clinical features
        y0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
        y1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
        t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(y1, y0, equal_var=False)
        t_stats.append(abs(t_stat))
    
    # Select top features by t-statistic
    top_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1][:10]
    top_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in top_indices]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    to_remove = set()
    if len(top_features) > 1:
        corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in top_features]].T)
        for i in range(len(top_features)):
            for j in range(i+1, len(top_features)):
                if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) > 0.6:
                    to_remove.add(top_features[j])
    
    filtered_features = [fid for fid in top_features if fid not in to_remove]
    
    # Limit to MAX_DRIVERS
    if len(filtered_features) > MAX_DRIVERS:
        # Use the top features based on t-statistic
        t_scores = []
        for fid in filtered_features:
            i = feats.column(fid)
            y0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
            y1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
            t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(y1, y0, equal_var=False)
            t_scores.append(abs(t_stat))
        top_driver_indices = np.argsort(t_scores)[::-1][:MAX_DRIVERS]
        filtered_features = [filtered_features[i] for i in top_driver_indices]
    
    # Create weighted score from module features
    weights = np.ones(len(filtered_features))
    if len(filtered_features) > 0:
        # Simple approach: use simple averaging
        weights = np.ones(len(filtered_features))
    
    # Build design
    drivers = tuple(filtered_features)
    columns = tuple(filtered_features)
    products = ()
    loadings = dict(zip(filtered_features, weights))
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
